sources.name: NOAA CO-OPS harmonic constituents and datums
sources.operator: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS)
sources.timeSemantics: API exposes GMT/local phase metadata; adapters must preserve which phase field/convention was used
sources.notes: NOAA/NOS states most NOAA information is public domain unless otherwise noted and requests source acknowledgement. Always inspect product/item-specific notices. CO-OPS metadata exposes amplitude, phase_GMT, phase_local and speed; do not map these blindly to the internal harmonic model without documenting astronomical/nodal/epoch normalization.
